X = no. of heads in 3 coin flips

- `dbinom()`

```{r}
dbinom(2, 3, 0.5)
choose(3, 2)*(0.5)^2*(1-0.5)^1

dbinom(0:3, 3, 0.5) # binomial dist is symmetric (or bell shaped) when p is close to 0.5
```

- `pbinom()`: 

By default,
$$P(X \le q) = \sum_{i=0}^q P(X = i)$$

If we use the argument, `lower.tail = F`, then pbinom() gives you the prob to the right of a point.

$$P(X > q) = \sum_{i=q+1}^{\inf} P(X = i)$$


```{r}
dbinom(0:3, 3, 0.5)
```

```{r}
pbinom(2, 3, 0.5) # P(X=0)+P(X=1)+P(X=2)

0.125 + 0.375 + 0.375

pbinom(2, 3, 0.5, lower.tail = F) # P(X > 2) = P(X = 3)

1 - pbinom(2, 3, 0.5)

pbinom(1, 3, 0.5)  # P(X < 2)
```
